extraction_notes: The supplied datasheet is a four-page scanned PDF with revision V2.0 shown in the footer.
Curve points were read directly from plotted traces at visible grid positions on page 3; no fitted or interpolated curve values were added.
Page 1 maximum ratings include VRRM = 30 V, IF(AV) = 1.0 A at rated VR and TL = 65 degC, IFSM = 5.5 A, storage and operating junction temperature range -65 to +125 degC, and dv/dt = 1000 V/us.
The reverse-current table also specifies a maximum of 10 uA at VR = 5 V and TC = 25 degC; the scalar reverse_current field records the separate 60 uA maximum at rated DC voltage.
The capacitance characteristic is published as a typical curve only in page 3 Figure 4; no tabulated capacitance value, test frequency, or temperature is provided.
Reverse recovery time is not published in the supplied datasheet.
Page 3 Figures 5 and 6 describe thermal/current derating and forward power dissipation rather than diode electrical characteristic curves and were not included in curves.
